cohort_definitions.canonical: Real numeric x.com status URL corroborated by free public evidence; not directly rendered X.
cohort_definitions.matched: Same-author candidate is not automatically a low-distribution control.
cohort_definitions.control: Ordinary or low post with comparable distribution evidence, time and format; none verified.
cohort_definitions.secondary_exposure: Third-party labeled exposure, not official X views; observation time unknown.
cohort_definitions.secondary_velocity: Exposure per hour, not cumulative exposure.
cohort_definitions.sidecar: Unresolved status identity excluded from canonical.
